title: Reel three opening and Bull's career so far
summary: Allen dates the reel and recaps the career discussion, and Bull recalls leaving his Ken Colyer phase and starting his own band.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: This is reel three of Jeff Bull, Friday the 13th of May, 1966. How did we put the date on before?
No, I don't think we did.
Well, we were talking about your career. Where did we leave off? We'd gotten you to England once, huh?
I think we were talking about the bands in Australia, the sort of bands they were and things.
Yeah, and the dancing we talked about.
That's right, yeah. Anyway, what happened then? Oh, that's right. Well, from there, you know, I got off the Ken Colgate kick, started the band I had. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
